backend.role: optional persistent corpus, search, recursive discovery, retained-media, and server-side workflows

limitations: A static third-party page cannot read raw audio bytes out of a cross-origin YouTube iframe, so the user must explicitly share a tab and enable tab audio.
Browser transcription requires WebGPU and deliberately has no CPU, Python, or corpus-backend fallback.
The user stops tab sharing when playback is complete; the captured audio is kept only in memory and discarded after transcription.
The first browser transcription slice provides timed ASR segments but not alignment, diarization, or translation.

privacy.networkRequests: YouTube preview/oEmbed plus audio-analysis browser runtime and Whisper model assets
